title: Le sport chez nous, lundi 31 août

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Le sport chez nous, ce lundi matin.
turns.en: Sport here at home, this Monday morning.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Du côté des clubs, le mercato entre dans ses tout derniers jours.
turns.en: Around the clubs, the transfer window is in its very last days.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Arthur Theate est arrivé à Bologne,

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: et trois autres Diables rouges agitent cette fin de marché.
turns.en: and three other Belgium internationals are busy in the last of the window.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Fernandez-Pardo, Fofana et Raskin sont cités du côté de la Premier League.
turns.en: «Fernandez-Pardo», «Fofana» and «Raskin» are being linked with the Premier League.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Ce qui nous attend ensuite, du basket,

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: où les Belgian Cats ont bouclé leur préparation à Ostende, face au Japon.
turns.en: where the «Belgian Cats» have finished their preparation at Ostend, against Japan.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Elles abordent maintenant la Coupe du monde féminine.
turns.en: They now go into the women's World Cup.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Enfin, le football international, où le patron de la FIFA, Gianni Infantino, doit partir.
turns.en: Finally, international football, where the head of FIFA, «Gianni Infantino», must go.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: C'est ce qu'a estimé dimanche Michel Platini,
turns.en: That is what «Michel Platini» said on Sunday,

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: sur la chaîne française Canal Plus.

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.en: For the former president of UEFA,

turns.speaker: SPK1
turns.text: Gianni Infantino n'a pas respecté les règles du sport.
turns.en: «Gianni Infantino» has not respected the rules of the sport.

headline_en: Arthur Theate joins Bologna as the transfer window closes
summary_en: Arthur Theate joins Bologna as the transfer window closes
The Belgian Cats have finished preparing for the World Cup
